fusions.name: Strip the Overburden
fusions.desc: A scraping cut that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Exposed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Down to the Ley
fusions.desc: Cuts into a ley line under the target for 34 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles, and ignoring the target's resistances.

fusions.name: Dowsed Well
fusions.desc: Restores 4 mana a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: The Lower Lode
fusions.desc: When your mana runs out, you restore 15 mana. Once every 30 seconds.
